summary: This informational RFC makes specifications of cryptographic algorithms based on the Russian national standards GOST R 34.10-2012 and GOST R 34.11-2012 available to the Internet community. They cover pseudorandom functions, key agreement based on Diffie-Hellman, and a hash function for use in cryptographic protocols.

eli5.summary: A recipe book for secret-code tools from Russian national standards, shared so other programmers can build them into Internet software.
